requirements: R1: Reconcile internal task status with GitHub PR state to prevent false 'done' resolution when PR is closed without merge

slices.title: Patch synchronization discrepancy for closed-without-merge PRs
slices.jtbd: When implementing the state reconciliation for this epic, I want to update the background sync logic to recognize unmerged closed PRs, so that the task accurately reflects its real failure state on GitHub.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a task whose associated GitHub PR is closed but not merged,
When the synchronization job runs,
Then the task status is reverted to a pending or failed state and an appropriate log is written.
Given this behavior is critical, E2E and integration tests must prove this fix correctly catches closed-without-merge PRs without needing a separate QA slice.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce false positive task resolutions by 100%
